forecasts.name: Reader 1
forecasts.reason: Single mean about 197 plus an RL-like vote gain of about +22 (base +33, RL +21) because cap hits fall to about 25.

forecasts.name: Reader 2
forecasts.reason: Single mean ~196 plus an RL-like vote gain of ~+24, since the edit cuts cap hits (base +33 and RL +21 under the vote).

forecasts.name: Incomplete switch
forecasts.reason: If the 1.5x edit with the cue gives RL-like answers (few cap hits, errors only on hard problems), the 4-sample vote should gain about what RL's does (200 -> 221, +21), not the cued base's larger +33 from many cap hits: 197 + ~22 = 219.

forecasts.name: Stopping dose
forecasts.reason: Single mean ~186 plus RL's vote gain (+19-21), as the edit leaves few cap-hit abstentions and base-level precision.

forecasts.name: Capped abstains
forecasts.reason: The base's +33 vote gain came from its 77 cap abstentions; with 25 left the edit gains like RL (+20) on a ~190 mean.
